filas_sql.title: MODERATED ESTIMATION OF FOLD CHANGE AND DISPERSION FOR RNA-SEQ DATA WITH DESEQ2
filas_sql.abstract: IN COMPARATIVE HIGH-THROUGHPUT SEQUENCING ASSAYS, A FUNDAMENTAL TASK IS THE ANALYSIS OF COUNT DATA, SUCH AS READ COUNTS PER GENE IN RNA-SEQ, FOR EVIDENCE OF SYSTEMATIC CHANGES ACROSS EXPERIMENTAL CONDITIONS. SMALL REPLICATE NUMBERS, DISCRETENESS, LARGE DYNAMIC RANGE AND THE PRESENCE OF OUTLIERS REQUIRE A SUITABLE STATISTICAL APPROACH. WE PRESENT DESEQ2, A METHOD FOR DIFFERENTIAL ANALYSIS OF COUNT DATA, USING SHRINKAGE ESTIMATION FOR DISPERSIONS AND FOLD CHANGES TO IMPROVE STABILITY AND INTERPRETABILITY OF ESTIMATES. THIS ENABLES A MORE QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS FOCUSED ON THE STRENGTH RATHER THAN THE MERE PRESENCE OF DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION. THE DESEQ2 PACKAGE IS AVAILABLE AT HTTP://WWW.BIOCONDUCTOR.ORG/PACKAGES/RELEASE/BIOC/HTML/DESEQ2.HTML .

filas_sql.abstract: THE PRESENT STUDY WAS CARRIED OUT TO EVALUATE THE REHYDRATION CHARACTERISTICS OF SOLAR AND MECHANICALLY DRIED LABLAB BEAN (LABLAB PURPUREUS (L.) SWEET; HITHERTO DOLICHOS LABLAB) SEEDS. BEAN SEEDS WITH AND WITHOUT COAT WERE USED TO STUDY THE REHYDRATION PROPERTIES. THE REHYDRATION RATIOS WERE HIGHER FOR BOTH MECHANICALLY AND SOLAR DRIED BEAN SEEDS WITHOUT SEED COAT THAN THOSE WITH COAT. MECHANICALLY DRIED WITHOUT COAT BEAN SEEDS HAD REHYDRATION RATIO OF 2.34 WHILE WITH COAT WAS 2.06. FOR MECHANICALLY DRIED SAMPLES, THE CO-EFFICIENT OF RECONSTITUTION WERE 0.58 AND 0.56 FOR BEAN SEEDS WITHOUT AND WITH COAT, RESPECTIVELY, AND WERE HIGHER THAN THOSE OF SOLAR DRIED SAMPLES HAVING CO-EFFICIENT OF RECONSTITUTION OF 0.54 AND 0.52 FOR BEAN SEEDS WITHOUT AND WITH COAT, RESPECTIVELY. FOR BOTH MECHANICAL AND SOLAR DRYING THE REHYDRATION RATE CONSTANT WAS HIGHER FOR BEAN SEEDS WITHOUT COAT THAN THOSE WITH COAT. BOTH REHYDRATION RATIO AND REHYDRATION RATE INDICATED THAT MECHANICALLY AND SOLAR DRIED BEAN SEEDS SAMPLES WITHOUT COAT SHOWED BETTER RECONSTITUTION PROPERTIES THAN THOSE WITH COAT. BOTH FRESH AND DRIED BEAN SEEDS WITHOUT SEED COAT GAVE HIGHER NUTRIENT CONTENT THAN THEIR COUNTERPART WITH COAT. SOLAR AND MECHANICAL DRIED SEEDS WERE GOOD SOURCE OF NUTRIENTS. 3. **"DIRECT AND INDIRECT PHOTODEGRADATION OF ESTRIOL IN THE PRESENCE OF HUMIC ACID, NITRATE AND IRON COMPLEXES IN WATER SOLUTIONS" (2013)**: Este artículo aborda la fotodegradación directa e indirecta del estrógeno en presencia de ácido húmico, nitrato y complejos de hierro en soluciones acuosas, un tema relevante en el campo de la contaminación ambiental.

resultados.respuesta: El estudio del secado de mangos con energía solar se encuentra en el artículo "THERMAL PERFORMANCE OF INDIRECT FORCED CONVECTION SOLAR DRYER AND KINETICS ANALYSIS OF MANGO" (2018) en la revista APPL THERM ENG. resultados.respuesta:
En los artículos del corpus que se refieren a la energía solar, se mencionan varios tipos de productos agrícolas que pueden ser secados utilizando esta tecnología. Según el artículo titulado "Solar Drying of Agricultural Products: A Review" (2011), se abordan diferentes productos agrícolas que se pueden beneficiar del secado con energía solar. El artículo destaca que el secado solar es una técnica aplicable a una variedad de cultivos, incluyendo granos de café (como se menciona en otro artículo del corpus), frutas y verduras. Además, también se menciona la producción de tomates en invernaderos equipados con paneles solares flexibles (en el artículo "Greenhouse Tomato Production with Electricity Generation by Roof-Mounted Flexible Solar Panels" de 2012). Esto sugiere que productos como café, frutas y verduras pueden ser secados utilizando energía solar.

En resumen, aunque la fuente SQL no proporciona detalles específicos sobre los tipos de productos agrícolas secados con energía solar en el corpus, el artículo "Solar Drying of Agricultural Products: A Review" y otros artículos mencionan que cultivos como café, frutas y verduras son susceptibles a este tipo de procesamiento.
